description.zh: 圣骑士在 Beta 中的练级加点路线与逐点顺序。
description.en: Level-by-level Paladin talent orders in the Forever beta.

body.zh: 【惩戒 Beta 开荒】11 点全部投入惩戒系：招架、更短的审判冷却和额外暴击，20 级拿到命令圣印。 【防护 Beta 开荒】先要格挡与命中：盾牌壁垒提供格挡爆发，精确保证仇恨技能不落空，盾牌专精第 1 点把格挡转化为法力。
body.en: [Retribution Beta Start] All eleven points in Retribution: parry, a shorter Judgement cooldown, and extra critical strike, then Seal of Command at 20. [Protection Beta Start] Block and hit first: Redoubt for block spikes, Precision so your threat abilities land, and the first point of Shield Specialization to turn blocks into Mana.

body.zh: 以上方案来自 Beta 版本 1.60.1.70425 的公开数据整理，正式版本上线后可能需要重新验证。
body.en: These builds come from published data for beta build 1.60.1.70425 and may need re-verification at launch.
